items.title: Class X and XII 2027 date sheet released
items.summary: CBSE released the 2027 board date sheets on 6 Nov 2026. Exams start 16 Feb 2027 at 10:30 AM IST. Class XII: Entrepreneurship 19 Feb, Accountancy 23 Feb, Economics 16 Mar, Business Studies 1 Apr 2027. Class X: Social Science 8 Mar 2027. Every paper runs 10:30 AM to 1:30 PM. Check the official notice for any changes.

items.title: 2027 practical exam schedule not yet issued
items.summary: As of 2 Nov 2026, no notice on practical exam dates or guidelines for the 2027 boards is listed on the official CBSE circulars page. The only practical guidelines listed are for the 2026 supplementary exams. Your school will share dates once CBSE announces them.

items.title: LOC submission for 2026-27 main exams has closed
items.summary: CBSE issued the LOC circular on 21 Sep 2026 and sent reminders until 21 Oct 2026, which it called the last date. Ask your school to confirm that your name, subjects and details were entered correctly.

items.title: CBSE held a live Q&A on registration and LOC for 2027 boards
items.summary: CBSE ran a webinar to answer school questions on registration and LOC for the 2027 board exams. The press release is on the CBSE website.

items.title: 2026-27 curriculum for Classes 9 to 12 is released
items.summary: CBSE released its curriculum for the 2026-27 session in April 2026 (circular Acad-14/2026). Download your subject syllabus from the Academic website.
